design_status: New fixed baseline implementations; not historical reproductions

labels.mapping_rule: model_id = dataset_id - 1; preserve distinct dataset classes 2 and 4

tokenizer.name: fixed_unicode_word_punctuation_v1
tokenizer.ordering: descending training frequency, lexical token tie break
tokenizer.padding: right; dynamic batch length; minimum length 5 for CNN kernels

embedding.oov_initialization: seeded independent Normal(0, 0.05) for training vocabulary misses and UNK; shared UNK for validation-only tokens

cnn.pooling: max over valid convolution windows; pad-only windows excluded
cnn.short_sequence_rule: one right-zero-padded window if token length is shorter than kernel

lstm.pooling: last actual token output; gather at length-1, never padded final output

training.early_stopping_rule: patience counts epochs without improvement >0.001 over meaningful best; stop after min epochs
training.checkpoint_rule: save every strict increase of validation Macro F1; earliest epoch wins exact ties
training.class_weighting: sqrt(N/(6*n_c)), normalized to mean 1; training counts only
training.device_policy: MPS if architecture's finite forward/backward smoke passes; otherwise CPU with recorded reason
training.deterministic_algorithms: enabled with warn_only=True; hardware/library nondeterminism remains possible

evaluation.probabilities: CPU float64 softmax of saved float32 logits; 17-digit CSV and lossless NPY
evaluation.scope: reused frozen validation, not final held-out performance
evaluation.forbidden: No held-out data access, no synthetic data, no historical augmented corpus, no contaminated checkpoints
